BATCH-061 ran two parallel tracks: (A) monodromy analysis of Semaev cover (KN-OPEN-009); (B) exhaustive search for publicly computable non-simulable oracle (KN-OPEN-005). Both produced definitive theoretical results.
BATCH-106: KN-FIND-4c9e71 promoted (adversarial max C ~ O(1)). H-PSEUDO-83817b updated. Continuing the loop with investigation of C stability at p=50021 adversarial.

BATCH-095: Extension-field analysis. Result: extension-field Semaev succeeds because its factor base IS algebraic (Frobenius condition). Prime-field Semaev REQUIRES non-algebraic factor base (Bezout-forced). H-PSEUDO asks for algebraic-type Fourier flatness without algebraic mechanism — genuinely new phenomenon.
BATCH-062 ran EXP-YIELD-004 (direct m=2 Semaev yield measurement) and promoted three KN-FIND items. EV-YIELD-e1adbf shows yield converges to heuristic from below; no super-heuristic signal at m=2.
BATCH-081: Weil bound approach for H-PSEUDO is CLOSED. DL circularity recurs. Empirically: |hat{1_F}(k)| ~ sqrt(B)*p^{0.079} (not sqrt(N)).

BATCH-100: Track A (special prime classes) — no systematic difference in C(p); p≡1 vs p≡3 mod 4 both give C≈3.7 at bits~14. Track B — two new H-PSEUDO ideas: IDEA-28c15f (ECCG security → H-PSEUDO conditional), IDEA-24b025 (linear complexity proxy).
BATCH-115: Near-optimal B measurements. Speedup at m=3,4,5: 2.62x, 2.82x, 4.24x. Gamma scales as ~0.66^{m-2}. Net speedup: ~3-5x at crypto scale.
BATCH-077 measured C at p=50021. Combined with BATCH-073/074/076: C(p) ~ p^{0.055} (very slow growth). H-PSEUDO holds in practical sense.

BATCH-072 analyzed three approaches to proving H-PSEUDO. All three approaches are blocked by fundamental mathematical obstructions (structural incompatibility, circularity, or wrong Fourier direction).
BATCH-111: BKK speedup at p=4001. B/2 gives 75.5% yield (vs 86% at p=1009). Speedup is regime-dependent: stronger in saturated regime (heuristic > 1.5).
BATCH-063 extended yield measurement to m=3 (RUN-YIELD-005). Combined with BATCH-062 m=2 result: no super-heuristic Semaev yield at m=2 or m=3.
BATCH-099: Hybrid MITM-decomposition analysis. AM-GM lower bound: two-table MITM requires |A|+|B| ≥ 2*sqrt(N). Index calculus cannot replace one table for prime-order curves. Hybrid formally closed.
BATCH-087: Tate pairing analysis for MAGCS. Result: MAGCS provable for k=2 (MOV-vulnerable) curves, but inapplicable to generic cryptographic curves (large k).

BATCH-082: Weyl/WvdC differencing approach for H-PSEUDO is CLOSED. Three independent failures: correlation sum = B² (exact obstruction), C_h bounds require DL circularity, even circular bound gives O(N^{3/4}*B^{1/4}).

BATCH-102: LC correlation measurement. EC C=3.13 > random C=2.57 at p=1009. EC sequences are LESS Fourier-flat than random bijections. High LC does not imply high Fourier flatness. IDEA-24b025 (LC proxy) blocked.

BATCH-069 attempted to measure the OIFP MITM constant C at larger bit sizes (bits=21,22,23) to determine if C=O(1) or grows with p. The computation hit resource limits (BFS enumeration + random-walk at bits≥21 requires > 120s per rep at this scale).
BATCH-076 extended H-PSEUDO measurement to p=4001 and p=9001. C grows slowly: p=1009→3.0, p=4001→3.5, p=9001→3.7. Possible O(log p) growth.
BATCH-101: ECCG → H-PSEUDO reduction analysis. Blocked by precision mismatch: normalized bias C/sqrt(p) ~ 2^{-128} at crypto scale is undetectable by any PPT.
